maria.support: Customer report: OAuth flow fails at callback with state mismatch for GitHub+Google SSO. Happens only on Safari iOS behind their reverse proxy. They pasted the final callback URL and header dump.

maria.support: final URL (copied): https://app.example.com/auth/callback?code=gho_ABC123&state=eyJzIjoiZm9vKzIyJTIrYnJhbmQ%2BMTIz%3D
maria.support: request UA: Mozilla/5.0 (iPhone; CPU iPhone OS 16_3 like Mac OS X) AppleWebKit/605.1.15 (KHTML, like Gecko) Version/16.3 Mobile/15E148 Safari/604.1
maria.support: cookie header they sent: Cookie: _r_state=eyJzIjoiZm9vKzIy
maria.support: they also have a second cookie chunk: _r_state_1=YnJhbmQ%2BMTIz

tom.devrel: Can you paste the raw header lines (not redacted) and which proxy (edge vs partner)?

maria.support: Partner proxy: rewrite service v2.2. Raw server log snippet attached below.

maria.support: ```
[auth] callback incoming path=/auth/callback code=gho_ABC123 state_recv="eyJzIjoiZm9vKzIy+YnJhbmQ+MTIz=" cookie_state="eyJzIjoiZm9vKzIy%2BYnJhbmQ%2BMTIz%3D" result=state_mismatch
```

oliver.infra: This screams encoding normalization + cookie chunk reassembly. Safari (and some deeplink handlers) will turn %2B into + when building the redirect string; if our cookie reassembly preserves the percent-encoded form we compare different raw bytes. Also if cookie chunks are stitched with no canonical normalization we can end up with mixed encodings.

oliver.infra: Two quick hypotheses: 1) proxy is decoding + vs %2B inconsistently when forwarding. 2) cookie chunk joiner is not normalizing to a canonical form before compare.

chris.prod-sre: Can we repro locally? Steps to try:
1) Start auth server locally with cookie chunking enabled.
2) Simulate redirect where the query param state contains a "+" (plus) instead of "%2B".
3) Send cookie chunks that contain percent-encoded characters.

maria.support: Customer sent HAR file and a short screen recording. They say "works on Chrome desktop" but fails on iOS Safari.

tom.devrel: Repro instructions we can send customer:
- Open Safari iOS, go through GitHub SSO.
- When it fails, long-press the address bar -> copy URL and paste into notes; send that plus the cookie header from the HAR.
- If possible toggle without the partner proxy or run direct to our LB to see if proxy is the culprit.

oliver.infra: Short-term mitigation: make state compare tolerant: canonicalize both sides before compare. Algorithm: percent-decode both values with UTF-8, then re-encode with base64url normalization (no "+" "/"). That avoids "+" vs "%2B" mismatches. Also, prefer storing hashed(state) server-side and compare hashes of the normalized form.

chris.prod-sre: I'll prepare a small hotfix: on auth callback, run normalize_state(input) that: decodeURIComponent(stateParam.replace(/\+/g, '%2B')) then compare base64url(stateCookie) == base64url(stateParam). Rollout window: 30m canary in prod route /auth/callback. Need approvals: oliver, tom.

oliver.infra: OK but log only hashed states in case of leaks. Also add a metric for state_mismatch_count so we can detect if tolerance hides real attacks.

deploy-bot: scheduled deploy auth-hotfix/2026-03-17T15:20Z -> canary (1%) -> prod if green.

maria.support: I'll ask customer to try the workaround: reduce state payload (shorter trace id) and re-test. Also asked for full HAR and the partner proxy config.

maria.support: Customer replied with HAR and says switching to direct LB made the flow succeed. Confirming proxy rewrite likely culprit. Marking this one P1 and escalating to partner team. :eyes:
